comment:
* Helper methods for reading elements from a {@link XmlPullParser}.
 *
 * @hide

methods.name: public static void readDocumentStartTag(TypedXmlPullParser parser, String expectedRootTag) throws XmlParserException, IOException
methods.comment:
* Check parser is currently at {@link XmlPullParser#START_DOCUMENT} and that it has a start tag * with expected root tag name. * *

The parser will be pointing to the root start tag found after this method.

methods.name: public static void readDocumentStart(TypedXmlPullParser parser) throws XmlParserException, IOException
methods.comment:
* Check parser is currently at {@link XmlPullParser#START_DOCUMENT}. * *

The parser will be pointing to the first tag in the document.

methods.name: public static void readDocumentEndTag(TypedXmlPullParser parser) throws XmlParserException, IOException
methods.comment:
* Check parser is currently at {@link XmlPullParser#END_TAG} and that has the expected root tag * name, and that the next tag is the {@link XmlPullParser#END_DOCUMENT} tag. * *

The parser will be pointing to the end document tag after this method.

methods.name: public static boolean readNextTagWithin(TypedXmlPullParser parser, int outerDepth) throws XmlParserException, IOException
methods.comment:
* Read the next tag and returns true if it's a {@link XmlPullParser#START_TAG} at depth * {@code outerDepth + 1} or false if it's a {@link XmlPullParser#END_TAG} at * {@code outerDepth}. Any other tag will fail this check. * *

The parser will be pointing to the next nested start tag when this method returns true, * or to the end tag for given depth if it returns false. * * @return true if start tag found within given depth, false otherwise

methods.name: public static void readEndTag(TypedXmlPullParser parser) throws XmlParserException, IOException
methods.comment:
* Check parser has a {@link XmlPullParser#END_TAG} as the next tag, with no nested tags. * *

The parser will be pointing to the end tag after this method.

methods.name: public static void readEndTag(TypedXmlPullParser parser, String tagName, int tagDepth) throws XmlParserException, IOException
methods.comment:
* Check parser has a {@link XmlPullParser#END_TAG} with same {@code tagDepth} as the next tag, * with no more nested start tags. * *

The parser will be pointing to the end tag after this method.

methods.name: public static int readAttributeIntNonNegative(TypedXmlPullParser parser, String attrName, int defaultValue) throws XmlParserException
methods.comment:
* Read attribute from current tag as a non-negative integer, returning default value if
     * attribute is missing.

methods.name: public static int readAttributeIntNonNegative(TypedXmlPullParser parser, String attrName) throws XmlParserException
methods.comment: Read attribute from current tag as a non-negative integer.

methods.name: public static int readAttributeIntInRange(TypedXmlPullParser parser, String attrName, int lowerInclusive, int upperInclusive) throws XmlParserException
methods.comment: Read attribute from current tag as an integer within given inclusive range.

methods.name: public static float readAttributeFloatInRange(TypedXmlPullParser parser, String attrName, float lowerInclusive, float upperInclusive, float defaultValue) throws XmlParserException
methods.comment:
* Read attribute from current tag as a float within given inclusive range, returning default
     * value if attribute is missing.
